claims.citation: New York Herald, 30 September 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship Adele (Belg), Claussen, Antwerp, 63 days, with mdse
and 51 passengers, to W F Schmidt's Son & Co. Experienced
very heavy weather on the passage; stove bulwarks, broke
mainyard, shipped several heavy seas, which washed every-
thing movable from the decks and disabled several of the
men.
